name: dev.out-box/mcp
title: Outbox
description: Publish and manage HTML pages in your agents-first Outbox library from any MCP client.

environmentVariables.name: OUTBOX_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Outbox API key (Bearer `outbox_*`). Without it (or the CLI's ~/.outboxrc) the server still starts and every tool asks you to configure it.

environmentVariables.name: OUTBOX_USER
environmentVariables.description: Owner username used as the default `user` argument, skipping a call to /api/me (optional).

environmentVariables.name: OUTBOX_RC
environmentVariables.description: Alternative path to the CLI credential file (default ~/.outboxrc).

environmentVariables.name: OUTBOX_API_BASE
environmentVariables.description: API base URL (everything, including content reads). Default https://api.out-box.dev.

environmentVariables.name: OUTBOX_SITE_BASE
environmentVariables.description: Public site base URL, only used to build the link shown to the human. Default https://out-box.dev.

environmentVariables.name: OUTBOX_TOOLSETS
environmentVariables.description: Toolsets to register: core, comments, library, sharing, keys, teams, automation, apps or all. Default core,comments.

environmentVariables.name: OUTBOX_FILES_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Folder where the MCP reads/writes files via file_path (nothing outside it). Default ~/Outbox.
